name: Sophia Ivanovna Deva
original_name: ソフィーヤ・イヴァーノヴナ・ジェーヴァ
source:
A Russian vampire researcher.

[spoiler]She used to work at the same laboratory Elina was held. However unlike the other researchers she was friendly towards her. They meet again later in Aqua Eden where she helps Elina stay out of the hands of the Russians.[/spoiler]
